line_items.description: Operator and Observer Training + Instructor Training: $6,000 + $600 per period × 5 = $33,000 total; Course Development: $6,000 + $6,000 per period × 5 = $60,000 total
Travel for Operational Support: NTE $50,000 per ordering period × 5 periods

Mission Days Operational support ($85,500 per period × 5) + Operational/Testing Support ($36,000 per period × 5) included in firm amounts; NRE Labor Categories (Technical Documentation, Modeling, NHC Integration) are NTE at $66,000 each per period but billed by task order
